title: Pan-Seared Australian Cod with Velvety Soup
description: A delicate cod fillet served with a rich and creamy velvety soup, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the cod fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the velvety soup in a separate pot over low heat.
Serve the cod fillets with the velvety soup spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
